scenario.title: One body-lung-body experiment across coarse and five-lobe pulmonary models
scenario.research_question: Can a single body-organ experiment retain its entity, route, ownership, population, substance, and flow meaning when only the pulmonary model resolution changes?

limitations: The synthetic body graph verifies composition and conservation; it is not an anatomical whole-body reference.
The coarse two-second transit is a software-test value, whereas the five-lobe model uses a literature-derived 6.4-second aggregate transit.
Equal domain meaning requires identity, route, ownership, and payload agreement; it does not require models at different resolution to produce identical timing or internal state.
This regression does not yet expose general body-organ composition through the command-line experiment manifest.
